instructions: Read the primary source in full. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: VoLLMは音声対話LLMのトークン間遅延と発話の滑らかさを重視したサービング。オフライン遅延上限制約プロファイラ、オンライン時間予算適応プリエンプション、音声・LLMモジュール別の状態付きバッチ実行を組み合わせる。IEEE Computer Societyの原著要旨は複数NVIDIA GPUで平均応答遅延を最大92.7%削減し流暢な出力を保証すると報告。
title: VoLLM: Smoothness-aware Serving of LLM-powered Voice Q&A via Adaptive Preemption
venue: IEEE International Parallel and Distributed Processing Symposium
